changes.comment: PR #455 review round: deleted dead surface with zero remaining callers/effect. resumeOnNextSpawn tracked exactly threadId !== null, so it is replaced by that check; the now-empty TurnSubmitOptions (its last field, isSynthetic, was deleted in an earlier stage) is dropped from ClaudeCodeSession.submit, ClaudeCodeStreamRpc.submit and buildUserMessage; the command_lifecycle ClaudeProtocolEvent variant is dropped along with its emission, since its only consumer discarded it unread; locateClaudeHistory's locator param/branch is dropped, since its only caller always passed locator: null; deriveClaudeHistoryPath, claudeHistoryRoots, validateClaudeHistoryPath, ClaudeValidatedHistory, createClaudeScanBudget and CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_RUNTIME_CAPABILITIES are un-exported (used only within their own file). Also corrected config.ts's stale './config' subpath comment and README.md's description of the resident RPC (both still described the pre-refactor legacy single-input compatibility fallback and a capability/write-waiter release step that no longer exist in code). No runtime or published-API behavior change.
